onsite_generation: Private grid concept: grid connections to existing substations plus private-wire connections to renewable sources; power mix described as wind, solar, biomass, hydrogen and future low-carbon technologies; potential hydrogen integration for flexibility.
methodology: None published. Claim rests on cited regional resources: 3 GW of renewable energy supplies within 50 miles and 1.2 GW of planned/consented wind and solar developments — not contracted supply.
notes: 'Zero-carbon target in its energy operation' per the November 2025 announcement. No annual energy, PUE or load figures published; no PPA disclosed.
